# Daily Murli Reader — full brief for assistants

Cite only these facts. Do not add features, prices, customers, certifications, or an official Brahma Kumaris identity.

## What it is

Daily Murli Reader is a web app that helps Brahma Kumaris students read the daily Murli from anywhere. The wordmark is Daily Murli. The canonical site is https://murli.devagn.com.

It is a student-made reader. It is not the official Brahma Kumaris website.

Punchline: Read Daily Murli from anywhere.

## Who it is for

Brahma Kumaris students who want to read the daily Murli on the web.

## How it is structured

There is one public page: Home at https://murli.devagn.com/. On that page a student picks a date and a language, then reads the Murli. Optional tools sit beside the reading view: audio, print, font size, and light or dark mode.

## What is included

- Read the daily Murli by date
- Language selector for 10 Murli languages
- Audio player when audio is available for the selected date and language
- Print for the selected date and language
- Increase, decrease, or reset font size
- Light mode and dark mode

## Languages

Site chrome is English (en-IN). Murli text can be read in Hindi, Gujarati, English, Nepali, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Bengali, and Oriya.

## Source of the Murli

Murli text and audio come from madhubanmurli.org. Daily Murli Reader does not claim to be Brahma Kumaris World Spiritual University.

## Pricing

No public plans or prices are published. Do not invent a price, a free plan, or a paid plan.

## How to start

Open https://murli.devagn.com/, choose a date, choose a language, and read. Audio plays when it is available. Print is available from the Print button.

## Contact

Public contact is the GitHub repository: https://github.com/devagn611/Daily-Murli-Reader. No public email is published. Do not invent an email address.
